claim: Aligned JP source labels to EN canonical labels: _normalize_source_label() maps "10-Q"/"earnings release" to "sec-filing" and "Yahoo Finance company metrics"/"Analyst consensus: Metrics"/"Metrics" to "yfinance". The source display policy applies the same normalization to EN and JP, collapses identical post-normalization source cells to table_note, and displays canonical notes as "SEC 10-Q (Q1 FY2027)" or "Yahoo Finance metrics". Three JP-EN parity tests and the V2.7 bundle pass. WIKI.md updated.

checks.name: Normalization assertions verify rules 1-4
command: PYTHONPATH=. backend/.venv/bin/python -c "from backend.earnings_deep_dive.mapper import _normalize_source_label, _restore_source_display, _apply_source_display_policy; from backend.earnings_deep_dive.report_model import RenderedTable, RenderedTableRow; assert _normalize_source_label('NVIDIA FY2027 Q1 10-Q (supplied metrics)') == 'sec-filing'; assert _normalize_source_label('Q1 FY2027 earnings release (supplied metrics)') == 'sec-filing'; assert _normalize_source_label('Yahoo Finance company metrics') == 'yfinance'; assert _normalize_source_label('Analyst consensus: Metrics') == 'yfinance'; assert _normalize_source_label('Metrics') == 'yfinance'; assert _restore_source_display('sec-filing') == 'SEC 10-Q (Q1 FY2027)'; assert _restore_source_display('yfinance') == 'Yahoo Finance metrics'; table=RenderedTable(columns=['Metric','Value','Source'], rows=[RenderedTableRow(label='A', cells=['1','Yahoo Finance company metrics']), RenderedTableRow(label='B', cells=['2','Analyst consensus: Metrics'])]); result=_apply_source_display_policy('Guidance', table); assert result.source_display_policy == 'table_note'; assert result.table_source_note == 'Source: Yahoo Finance metrics'; print('ALL normalization assertions PASS')"
